label: Before repairs
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: KING LEO area 25, The Sealed Dungeon, STATE 0 before repairs. Generate one portrait 9:16 environment still. The input is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the approved gate's warm royal 3D animation quality, but create this DIFFERENT location.
STYLE: Premium warm royal 3D animated-film environment: rounded bevelled cream sandstone, honey oak, polished brass, royal blue and gold, vivid healthy greenery, warm sunlight, clean dimensional materials. Bright cartoon colour, no gritty photorealism, no gloomy brown wash. Portrait 9:16, fixed camera, readable repair subjects, no UI or typography.
SCENE AND ALL INITIAL DAMAGE: Royal castle dungeon rescue passage rendered in bright warm friendly 3D, cream sandstone with brass lantern mounts and royal-blue small accents. A central locked iron-bar cell door, shallow flooded stone corridor in foreground, broken little lifting winch at right, unlit wall lanterns, closed outer iron grate farther up right stairwell, cracked tunnel ceiling with broken timber brace, small distinct rubble heap at left of stairs. A quiet modest cell interior is visible behind bars; no torture, gore, skeletons, threatening figures, or horror lighting. Warm daylight shaft from distant stairs keeps all repair subjects legible. No living characters in initial state.
COMPOSITION: fixed slightly elevated three-quarter camera, fit the entire small room or courtyard into one portrait composition, broad readable shapes, keep every listed repair subject visible and spatially separated. No collage or cutaway panels. Main room occupies central 75%, a quiet foreground floor or path occupies lower 20%, architecture visible above. Clear 3D depth, soft shadows and ambient occlusion; materials are smooth but detailed, not plastic toys. The space needs repair but is still cheerful, sunlit, colourful and inviting.
LATER repairs, NONE done yet, in this exact order: 1. Break the cell door; 2. Clear the flooded corridor; 3. Repair the winch; 4. Light the way out; 5. Force the outer grate; 6. Shore up the tunnel; 7. Clear the last rubble; 8. Carry her up.
Do not add living characters unless explicitly required. No UI, labels, readable words, logos, watermark, floating icons, particles, construction workers or tools being operated. One standalone portrait image with no border.
